clues.text: This town sits far east of Johannesburg. It sits just west of Kruger National Park.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the Johannesburg to Kruger National Park area of South Africa

source.quote: Sabie is located 360 km (220 mi) east of Johannesburg and 64 km (40 mi) west of the popular Kruger National Park.

clues.text: Rain falls here most in summer, but winter brings very little rain. The land turns so dry in winter that forest fires are common then.
clues.narrowing: rules out places without a summer rain and dry winter pattern

source.quote: It is situated approximately 1,066 metres (3,497 feet) above sea level and is in the summer rainfall area. During the winter period, there is little rainfall, and the area can become intensely dry. Forest fires are prevalent during this time, therefore precautions are taken beforehand to create fire breaks, as well as to incorporate block burning.

clues.text: The town began after Glynn and Ingle found gold here. They then formed their own gold mining company.
clues.narrowing: rules out towns in the area that did not start with this gold find

source.quote: The town was started after H.T. Glynn and J.C. Ingle found gold there and formed the Glynns-Lydenburg Gold Mining Company.

clues.text: The woods planted around this town form one of the largest man made forests on Earth.
clues.narrowing: rules out almost every other town; few places sit in a man made forest this large

source.quote: Its main industry is forestry. The plantations surrounding Sabie form one of the world's largest man-made forests.

clues.text: Just out of town, the Lone Creek Falls draw crowds as the most loved sight here. Many other falls splash in and around town too.
clues.narrowing: confirms the town known for Lone Creek Falls and its many waterfalls

source.quote: There are many attractions in and around the town itself. Of these the most popular is the Lone Creek Falls about 10 km (6 mi) outside town. There are many other waterfalls in the area, such as the Bridal Veil, Maria Shire, Horseshoe, Forest Falls, and the Sabie River falls situated within the town itself.
